Mumbai: DRI busts an airport-insider smuggling ring moving gold and diamonds through CSMIA.

મુંબઈ: DRIએ CSMIA એરપોર્ટ પર સોનું-હીરાની દાણચોરીનું રેકેટ ઝડપ્યું.

Eight were arrested, including a food-court ground staffer who allegedly helped transit passengers from Dubai move 8,320 grams of gold worth Rs12.64 crore and diamonds worth Rs1.10 crore out of the terminal.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs13,274/g, 22K Rs12,169/g, silver Rs1,98,824/kg -- 25 Sept tape close.
